challenges.name: Bug Buffet
challenges.description: Five rounds of edible bugs, each one bigger and crunchier than the last: roasted crickets, mealworms, chocolate-covered ants, grasshoppers, then a whole tarantula. Each influencer has 60 seconds per round to eat their plate. Skip a round and you're out; the last one standing wins. Food-grade insects only, from a licensed supplier. Insects can set off shellfish allergies, so Culinary checks the allergy list and everyone signs the food waiver before the shoot.
challenges.rewards: Immunity from the week's elimination vote, plus a $250 cash prize.
challenges.location_details: Kitchen island set as the tasting table; contestants seated facing the main camera
challenges.cleanup_plan: Bag every leftover insect and throw it out the same night (sealed, outside bins). Wipe and sanitize the island, plates and floor; empty and rinse the barf buckets outside.

challenges.name: Jello Wrestling Showdown
challenges.description: Bracket-style wrestling in a kiddie pool full of jello. Two influencers per match, two minutes per match: first to pin their opponent for a three count, or knock them out of the pool, wins. A referee calls every match, and fans pick the wild-card for the final. Make the jello two days ahead so it sets. Shoot in the backyard on tarps; no slick floors indoors.
challenges.rewards: Winner picks the week's group dinner and gets the best bedroom for three nights.
challenges.location_details: On tarps on the lawn, away from the pool deck; nothing slippery goes inside
challenges.cleanup_plan: Scoop the jello into contractor bags (not down the drains), deflate and hose out the pool, rinse and dry the tarps and crash mats, then hose down the lawn. Influencers rinse off at the outdoor shower before going in.

challenges.name: Mud Pit Gauntlet
challenges.description: Two teams race through the grossest obstacle course we can build in the backyard: belly-crawl through a mud pit under a cargo net, slide down a slime slip-and-slide, squeeze through a tunnel of cold spaghetti, then dig through a tub of fish bait with bare hands for the key that unlocks the finish. Each team member runs one leg; the fastest team time wins. Course layout still to be confirmed with the house owner, and the yard has to be put back afterward.
challenges.rewards: Winning team gets a catered spa afternoon; the losing team cleans the course.
challenges.location_details: Full length of the side yard; course layout still to be confirmed with the house owner
challenges.cleanup_plan: The losing team does a first pass on camera. Then crew drain and remove the mud pit and pond liner, bag the spaghetti and bait for the outside bins, roll up the slip-and-slides, and re-sod or rake the yard back to how we found it. Photograph the yard before setup to compare.

supplies.name: First aid kit and eye-wash station

challenges.name: Gross-Out Smoothie Roulette
challenges.description: Ten covered cups on a spinning lazy Susan. Some hold a normal fruit smoothie; the rest are blended from things like sardines, pickle juice, hot sauce, liver and old coffee. Influencers spin, drink the whole cup in 30 seconds and rate it for the camera. Fans vote on who has to drink the final 'everything' cup. Culinary writes down every ingredient and checks it against the allergy list.
challenges.rewards: The last one to tap out hosts the next live stream and gets a $500 cash prize.
challenges.location_details: Lazy Susan on the kitchen island; blending done off camera in the back kitchen
challenges.cleanup_plan: Pour out leftover smoothies outside, run the blenders and cups through the dishwasher twice, and give the blenders back to Culinary clean. Sanitize the island and empty the barf buckets outside.
